runtime.command_template: python tools/rab_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game rab_320 --rom-path <read-only-rom-root> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/data-east/rab-320-<run>.json --boot-wait 8 --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. No keyboard handling: every stimulus is a direct public switch write (the Black Advance button at -7, the Green input at -6, then playfield and cabinet addresses). tools/rab_harness.py replaces only the display-title checkpoint with exact title-band matches of visually read retained frames (tools/rab_header_templates.json). Each DMD reading in diagnostic_snapshots was read by a curator from the retained 128x32 frame whose pixel digest is recorded beside it.

hat-trick-award.note: The host held the VUK switch 52 closed from the ball's arrival until the ROM fired 4, and opened it at once. Times are host-clock seconds between the harness's switch and solenoid callbacks, rounded to 0.1 s, so a loaded host can stretch them; the per-award figures are in the curator facts.

nell-expires.note: The host held each drop target switch closed while its target was down and released all five about 3 s after the bank was completed, so the reset coil 15 retried while they stayed closed. Relay 9 timings are in the curator facts.

save-nell.note: The host held each drop target switch closed while its target was down and released all five about 3 s after the bank was completed, so the reset coil 15 retried while they stayed closed. Relay 9 timings are in the curator facts.

trough-serve.note: The host moved the balls: a ball reached or left a switch only when the host wrote it, so the pulse counts measure the ROM's retries, not travel times. Counts exclude the light-show outputs (10, 11, 23 and 25-32).
